rules: Upon reset, the mstatus field MIE is reset to 0.
Upon reset, the mstatus field MPRV is reset to 0.
Upon reset, if little-endian memory accesses are supported, the mstatus or mstatush field MBE is reset to 0.
When TSR=1 in mstatus, the SRET instruction raises an illegal-instruction exception.
When TW=1 in mstatus, the WFI instruction may raise an illegal-instruction exception.
The operation of WFI is unaffected by the global interrupt bits MIE and SIE in mstatus.
